# Device location refresh deduplication (2026-01-18 15:14Z)

_**User**_

 Deduplicate the device-location refresh pipeline
Why: refreshAllDeviceLocations is duplicated across iPhone and iPad devices views with nearly identical logic (and similar notification handlers). This is a prime target for moving into a shared service or view model, reducing complexity and the risk of drift.
Where:
miataru/miataru/views/iPhone/iPhone_DevicesView.swift (refresh method + NotificationCenter handlers)
miataru/miataru/views/iPad/iPad_DevicesView.swift (refresh method + NotificationCenter handlers)
Refactor idea:
Extract a shared DeviceLocationRefresher (e.g., in a new LocationManagers helper) with refreshAllDeviceLocations(forceGeocoding:) and throttling logic.
Call it from both views; keep view-specific concerns (navigation, list selection) local.
Cites: iPhone_DevicesView.swift and iPad_DevicesView.swift show identical refresh logic and throttling blocks.

---

_**Agent (model default, mode Plan)**_


Analyzing the current implementation to identify duplication and plan the refactor.

        "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * SettingsManager.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport Foundation\nimport Combine\n\nclass SettingsManager: ObservableObject {\n    private let defaults = UserDefaults.standard\n    \n    // MARK: - Properties\n    @Published var disableDeviceAutolock: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(disableDeviceAutolock, forKey: Keys.disableDeviceAutolock) }\n    }\n    @Published var indicateAccuracyOnMap: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(indicateAccuracyOnMap, forKey: Keys.indicateAccuracyOnMap) }\n    }\n    @Published var groupsZoomToFit: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(groupsZoomToFit, forKey: Keys.groupsZoomToFit) }\n    }\n    @Published var miataruServerURL: String {\n        didSet {\n            defaults.set(miataruServerURL, forKey: Keys.miataruServerURL)\n            WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncWidgetConfig(\n                serverURL: miataruServerURL,\n                deviceIDs: KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices.map { $0.DeviceID },\n                ownDeviceID: thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\n            )\n        }\n    }\n    @Published var trackAndReportLocation: Bool {\n        didSet { \n            defaults.set(trackAndReportLocation, forKey: Keys.trackAndReportLocation)\n            // Check location permissions when tracking is enabled\n            if trackAndReportLocation {\n                checkAndRequestLocationPermissions()\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    @Published var saveLocationHistoryOnServer: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(saveLocationHistoryOnServer, forKey: Keys.saveLocationHistoryOnServer) }\n    }\n    @Published var locationDataRetentionTime: Int {\n        didSet { defaults.set(String(locationDataRetentionTime), forKey: \"location_data_retention_time\") }\n    }\n    @Published var mapType: Int {\n        didSet { defaults.set(String(mapType), forKey: Keys.mapType) }\n    }\n    @Published var mapUpdateInterval: Int {\n        didSet { defaults.set(String(mapUpdateInterval), forKey: Keys.mapUpdateInterval) }",

        "contents": "# miataru iOS App - Project Overview\n\n## 🎯 Project Purpose\nmiataru is a privacy-focused iOS application that enables users to track their device location, share it securely with trusted parties, and manage multiple devices and groups. The app prioritizes user privacy, battery efficiency, and cross-platform compatibility.\n\n## 🏗️ Architecture Overview\n\n### Technology Stack\n- **Frontend**: SwiftUI (iOS 18.0+)\n- **State Management**: ObservableObject pattern with @Published properties\n- **Data Persistence**: UserDefaults via SettingsManager; Application Support files for devices/groups\n- **Location Services**: CoreLocation framework (foreground and significant-change background)\n- **QR Code**: CodeScanner (scan), QRCode (generate)\n- **Platforms**: iPhone and iPad\n\n### Core Components\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nmiataruApp.swift (Entry Point)\n├── MiataruRootView (Main Navigation)\n├── OnboardingContainerView (User Setup)\n├── LocationManagers/\n│   └── LocationManager.swift\n├── SettingsManagers/\n│   └── App Settings/ (SettingsManager, thisDeviceIDManager, Settings.bundle)\n│   └── Devices/ (KnownDevice, KnownDeviceStore)\n│   └── Groups/ (DeviceGroup, DeviceGroupStore)\n├── views/\n│   ├── Common/ (Shared UI)\n│   ├── iPhone/ (iPhone-specific)\n│   ├── iPad/ (iPad-specific)\n│   └── Mac/ (onboarding previews only)\n└── Assets/ (Resources &amp; Localization)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Common Components Overview\n\n- Shared UI (&#96;views/Common/&#96;):\n  - &#96;ErrorOverlay&#96;, &#96;ViewModifiers&#96; (adaptive toolbars/navigation)\n  - Device &amp; group UI: &#96;DeviceRowView&#96;, &#96;GroupRowView&#96;, &#96;DeviceNameLabel&#96;, &#96;DeviceBatterySymbol&#96;\n  - Map UI &amp; helpers (&#96;views/Common/Map/&#96;): &#96;MiataruMapMarker&#96;, &#96;PulsingAccuracyCircle&#96;, &#96;MapScaleBar&#96; (+ &#96;MapScaleBarViewModel&#96;), &#96;MapCompass&#96;, &#96;OffScreenDeviceArrow&#96;, &#96;OffscreenDeviceEdgeHelper&#96;, &#96;RouteGhostCalculator&#96;, &#96;RouteStyle&#96;, &#96;Shimmer&#96;\n- Data &amp; Caching:\n  - &#96;KnownDeviceStore&#96;, &#96;DeviceGroupStore&#96; (secure archiving under Application Support)",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "            DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared.setLocation(\n                for: thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID,\n                latitude: location.coordinate.latitude,\n                longitude: location.coordinate.longitude,\n                accuracy: location.horizontalAccuracy,\n                timestamp: location.timestamp,\n                batteryLevel: batteryPercent,\n                altitude: altitudeValue,\n                speed: speedValue\n            )\n            self.sendLocationToServer(location)\n            self.addUpdateLogEntry(mode: mode)\n        }\n    }\n    func locationManager(_ manager: CLLocationManager, didChangeAuthorization status: CLAuthorizationStatus) {\n        Task { @MainActor in\n            self.authorizationStatus = status\n            // If permission is denied or restricted, update the setting to reflect the actual state\n            if status == .denied || status == .restricted {\n                if settings.trackAndReportLocation {\n                    debugLog(\"Location permission denied/restricted, setting trackAndReportLocation to false\")\n                    settings.trackAndReportLocation = false\n                }\n            }\n            if status == .authorizedWhenInUse,\n               settings.trackAndReportLocation,\n               !hasRequestedAlwaysAuthorization {\n                // Escalate to Always once, if user opted-in to tracking\n                debugLog(\"Authorized WhenInUse. Requesting Always authorization…\")\n                hasRequestedAlwaysAuthorization = true\n                self.locationManager.requestAlwaysAuthorization()\n            }\n            self.updateTrackingMode()\n        }\n    }\n    func locationManager(_ manager: CLLocationManager, didFailWithError error: Error) {\n        Task { @MainActor in\n            self.serverUpdateStatus = .failed(error.localizedDescription)\n        }\n    }\n} \n\nextension Notification.Name {\n    static let didSendOwnLocationUpdate = Notification.Name(\"didSendOwnLocationUpdate\")",

        "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * iPhone_LocationStatusView.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport SwiftUI\nimport CoreLocation\nimport UIKit\n\nstruct iPhone_LocationStatusView: View {\n    @ObservedObject private var locationManager = LocationManager.shared\n    @ObservedObject private var backgroundManager = LocationManager.shared\n    @ObservedObject private var routeCounter = RouteRequestCounter.shared\n    @ObservedObject private var settings = SettingsManager.shared\n    // Legacy @AppStorage fields removed in favor of RouteRequestCounter\n    \n    var body: some View {\n        ScrollView {\n            VStack(spacing: 16) {\n            // Status-Header\n            HStack {\n                Image(systemName: statusIcon)\n                    .foregroundColor(statusColor)\n                    .font(.title2)\n                \n                VStack(alignment: .leading) {\n                    Text(NSLocalizedString(\"Location Tracking Status\", comment: \"Header for location tracking status section\"))\n                        .font(.headline)\n                    Text(statusText)\n                        .font(.caption)\n                        .foregroundColor(.secondary)\n                    Text(trackingModeText)\n                        .font(.caption2)\n                        .foregroundColor(.gray)\n                }\n                \n                Spacer()\n                \n                // Tracking Toggle\n                Toggle(\"location_track\", isOn: $settings.trackAndReportLocation)\n                    .labelsHidden()\n            }\n            .padding()\n            .background(Color(.systemGray6))\n            .cornerRadius(12)\n            \n            // Hinweistext für Hintergrund-Tracking\n            if isInBackground {\n                Text(NSLocalizedString(\"Location updates in the background are only detected when they are significant (&gt;500m).\", comment: \"Hint for background location update behavior\"))\n                    ",

        "contents": "- Bicycle transport mode was removed; existing values fall back to walking for directions and car icons where applicable.\n\n**For developers:**\n- &#96;SettingsManager&#96; stores all preferences in &#96;UserDefaults&#96; and triggers side effects such as permission checks and auto‑refresh.\n- &#96;iPhone_SettingsView&#96; binds directly to these properties and navigates to &#96;iPhone_LocationStatusView&#96; (now a page) or re-runs the onboarding flow via &#96;AppState&#96;.\n- Defaults are registered from &#96;Settings.bundle&#96;, enabling control from the system Settings app. The manager observes low‑power state and scene phase for UI effect gating.\n- Reverse geocoding threshold is user‑configurable (off/100 m/1 km/10 km; default 1 km) and applied centrally.\n\n## Location Status &amp; Error Handling\n**For users:**\n- A dedicated status view shows permission state, last GPS and server updates, background activity, and a log of recent events.\n- If a network or permission error occurs, an overlay explains the problem.\n- Map screens additionally display a network-error icon when the server cannot be reached.\n\n- The status view lists speed and battery (when available) and tracks route‑request statistics over the last 24 hours.\n\n**For developers:**\n- &#96;LocationManager&#96; posts &#96;didSendOwnLocationUpdate&#96; notifications; &#96;ErrorOverlayManager&#96; and &#96;ErrorOverlay&#96; provide reusable alert UIs, and map views toggle a network icon via &#96;showNetworkErrorIcon&#96; flags.\n- Status is presented as a dedicated page; related counters (e.g., daily route requests) are maintained in settings/state for diagnostics.\n\n## Caching and Reverse Geocoding\n**For users:**\n- Device list rows display last seen time, distance, and approximate place name without requiring a network connection every time.\n- Cached data is also used by device and group maps so known positions remain visible offline until refreshed.\n\n**For developers:**\n- &#96;DeviceLocationCacheStore&#96; caches coordinates, manages a centralized reverse‑geocoding queue with a configurable distance threshold, and stores results in &#96;Application Support&#96;. Views consult the cache first before hitting the network and throttle UI updates to the configured map update interval.\n- Own‑device updates trigger immediate cache writes to kick off reverse geocoding promptly. A &#96;RouteCacheStore&#96; caches routes by device and transport, with distance‑based invalidation.",

Data(contentsOf: fileURL) else { return [] }\n        do {\n            if let devices = try NSKeyedUnarchiver.unarchivedObject(ofClasses: [NSArray.self, KnownDevice.self, UIColor.self], from: data) as? Gibt true zurück, wenn erfolgreich, false bei Duplikat.\n    @discardableResult\n    func add(device: KnownDevice) -&gt; Bool {\n        if devices.contains(where: { $0.DeviceID == device.DeviceID }) {\n            return false\n        }\n        devices.append(device)\n        return true\n    }\n\n    func move(fromOffsets source: IndexSet, toOffset destination: Int) {\n        devices.move(fromOffsets: source, toOffset: destination)\n        // Reihenfolge-Index aktualisieren\n        for (index, device) in devices.enumerated() {\n            device.KnownDevicesTablePosition = index\n        }\n        save()\n    }\n\n    func remove(atOffsets offsets: IndexSet) {\n        // Get device IDs that will be removed\n        let deviceIDsToRemove = offsets.map { devices[$0].DeviceID }",

        "contents": "    func remove(atOffsets offsets: IndexSet) {\n        // Get device IDs that will be removed\n        let deviceIDsToRemove = offsets.map { devices[$0].DeviceID }\n        \n        // Remove devices from the list\n        devices.remove(atOffsets: offsets)\n        \n        // Remove devices from all groups\n        removeDevicesFromAllGroups(deviceIDs: deviceIDsToRemove)\n        \n        save()\n    }\n    \n    func removeDevice(byID deviceID: String) {\n        // Remove device from the list\n        devices.removeAll { $0.DeviceID == deviceID }\n        \n        // Remove device from all groups\n        removeDevicesFromAllGroups(deviceIDs: [deviceID])\n        \n        save()\n    }\n    \n    private func removeDevicesFromAllGroups(deviceIDs: [String]) {\n        let groupStore = DeviceGroupStore.shared\n        \n        for group in groupStore.groups {\n            var changed = false\n            for deviceID in deviceIDs {\n                if group.deviceIDs.contains(deviceID) {\n                    group.removeDevice(deviceID)\n                    changed = true\n                }\n            }\n            if changed {\n                group.objectWillChange.send()\n            }\n        }\n    }\n} ",

        },
        "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * DeviceGroupStore.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport Foundation\nimport UIKit\nimport Combine\n\nclass DeviceGroupStore: ObservableObject {\n    static let shared = DeviceGroupStore()\n    \n    @Published var groups: [DeviceGroup] = [] {\n        didSet {\n            setupSubscribers()\n            save()\n        }\n    }\n    private let fileName = \"deviceGroups.plist\"\n    private var cancellables: [AnyCancellable] = []\n\n    private var fileURL: URL {\n        AppDirectories.applicationSupportFile(named: fileName)\n    }\n\n    // Make init private for singleton\n    private init() {\n        self.groups = load()\n        setupSubscribers()\n    }\n\n    private func setupSubscribers() {\n        cancellables = []\n        for group in groups {\n            let c = group.objectWillChange\n                .sink { [weak self] _ in\n                    self?.save()\n                }\n            cancellables.append(c)\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func save() {\n        do {\n            let data = try NSKeyedArchiver.archivedData(withRootObject: groups, requiringSecureCoding: true)\n            try data.write(to: fileURL)\n        } catch {\n            debugLog(\"Fehler beim Speichern der DeviceGroups: \\(error)\")\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func load() -&gt; [DeviceGroup] {\n        guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: fileURL) else { return [] }\n        do {\n            if let groups = try NSKeyedUnarchiver.unarchivedObject(ofClasses: [NSArray.self, DeviceGroup.self], from: data) as? [DeviceGroup] {\n                // Nach gespeicherter Reihenfolge sortieren\n                return groups.sorted { $0.groupPosition &lt; $1.groupPosition }\n            }\n        } catch {\n            debugLog(\"Fehler beim Laden der DeviceGroups: \\(error)\")\n        }\n        return []\n    }\n\n    func add(group: DeviceGroup) {\n        groups.append(group)\n    }\n\n    func move(fromOffsets source: IndexSet, toOffset destination: Int) {\n        groups.move(fromOffsets: source, toOffset: destination)",

        "contents": "- Stores &amp; caches:\n  - &#96;KnownDeviceStore&#96;, &#96;DeviceGroupStore&#96; (secure archiving to Application Support)\n  - &#96;DeviceLocationCacheStore&#96; (last locations + reverse geocode queue)\n  - &#96;RouteCacheStore&#96; (cached &#96;MKRoute&#96; by device &amp; transport; distance-based validity)\n- Utilities:\n  - &#96;thisDeviceIDManager&#96; (device ID generation + legacy migration)\n  - &#96;Haptic&#96; (success/warning/error feedback)\n\n### Key Dependencies\n- **CodeScanner**: QR code scanning functionality\n- **MiataruAPIClient** (via local &#96;Libraries/MiataruClientSwift&#96;): Miataru protocol client\n- **QRCode**: QR code generation\n- **SwiftImageReadWrite**: Image handling utilities\n\n## Development Workflow\n\n### Code Organization\n- **Views**: Keep UI logic minimal, delegate to managers\n- **Managers**: Handle business logic and data persistence\n- **Models**: Use SwiftUI's built-in data binding\n- **Assets**: Organize by platform and feature\n\n### Testing Strategy\n- Unit tests for managers and business logic\n- UI tests for critical user flows\n- Test on multiple device types (iPhone, iPad)\n- Verify location permission flows\n\n### Debugging Tips\n- Use Xcode's location simulation for testing\n- Monitor battery usage during development\n- Test background/foreground transitions\n- Verify privacy compliance\n - Test deep links: &#96;miataru://&lt;DEVICE_ID&gt;&#96; (Simulator: &#96;xcrun simctl openurl booted miataru://ABCDEF...&#96;)\n\n## Common Development Tasks\n\n### Adding New Features\n1. Create view in appropriate platform folder\n2. Add manager if business logic is needed\n3. Update settings if user preferences are involved\n4. Add localization strings\n5. (cached routes keyed by device/transport; distance threshold validation)\n- Utilities:\n  - &#96;thisDeviceIDManager&#96; (device ID generation + legacy migration)\n  - &#96;Haptic&#96; (feedback utilities)\n\n## 🔑 Key Features\n\n### Location Management\n- **Privacy-First**: User controls all location sharing\n- **Battery Optimized**: High-accuracy foreground; significant-change background\n- **Permission Handling**: Staged requests (WhenInUse → Always when opted-in)\n- **Background Support**: Significant-change updates\n\n### Device Management\n- **Multi-Device**: Track multiple devices\n- **Group Support**: Organize devices into groups\n- **QR Code Sharing**: Share own device, scan to add others\n- **Deep Link**: &#96;miataru://&lt;DEVICE_ID&gt;&#96;         "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * DeviceHistoryCacheStore.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport Foundation\nimport Combine\nimport MiataruAPIClient\n\nclass DeviceHistoryCacheStore: ObservableObject {\n    static let shared = DeviceHistoryCacheStore()\n    @Published private var histories: [String: [MiataruLocationData]] = [:]\n    private init() {}\n\n    func setHistory(_ history: [MiataruLocationData], for deviceID: String) {\n        histories[deviceID] = history\n    }\n\n    func getHistory(for deviceID: String) -&gt; [MiataruLocationData]? {\n        histories[deviceID]\n    }\n}",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

{
  "plan": "# Deduplicate Device Location Refresh Pipeline\n\n## Current State\nBoth &#96;iPhone_DevicesView.swift&#96; and &#96;iPad_DevicesView.swift&#96; contain nearly identical:\n- &#96;refreshAllDeviceLocations(forceGeocoding:)&#96; method (lines 242-283 in iPhone, 294-334 in iPad)\n- NotificationCenter handlers for &#96;.didSendOwnLocationUpdate&#96; and &#96;UIApplication.didBecomeActiveNotification&#96; with identical throttling logic (lines 172-211 in iPhone, 163-202 in iPad)\n\nThe only difference is iPhone includes a debugLog statement.\n\n## Solution\nCreate a shared &#96;DeviceLocationRefresher&#96; service that centralizes:\n1. The refresh logic (API calls, cache updates, geocoding)\n2. Throttling based on &#96;mapUpdateInterval&#96; and last refresh time\n3. Conditional refresh checks (visibility, app state, auto-refresh settings)\n\n## Implementation Steps\n\n### 1. Create DeviceLocationRefresher\n**File**: &#96;miataru/LocationManagers/DeviceLocationRefresher.swift&#96;\n\n- Singleton pattern (like &#96;LocationManager&#96;)\n- Properties:\n  - &#96;lastRefresh: Date?&#96; - shared throttle state\n  - &#96;settings: SettingsManager.shared&#96;\n  - &#96;store: KnownDeviceStore.shared&#96;\n  - &#96;cache: DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared&#96;\n- Methods:\n  - &#96;refreshAllDeviceLocations(forceGeocoding: Bool = false) async -&gt; Bool&#96; - core refresh logic\n  - &#96;shouldRefresh(isVisible: Bool) -&gt; Bool&#96; - checks throttle, visibility, app state, and auto-refresh setting\n  - &#96;refreshIfNeeded(isVisible: Bool, forceGeocoding: Bool = false) async -&gt; Bool&#96; - convenience method that combines checks and refresh\n\n### 2. Update iPhone_DevicesView.swift\n- Remove &#96;refreshAllDeviceLocations&#96; method (lines 242-283)\n- Remove &#96;@State private var lastDeviceListRefresh: Date? = nil&#96; (line 22)\n- Replace refresh calls:\n  - Line 155: &#96;await DeviceLocationRefresher.shared.refreshAllDeviceLocations(forceGeocoding: true)&#96;\n  - Lines 172-184: Replace notification handler with call to &#96;DeviceLocationRefresher.shared.refreshIfNeeded(isVisible: isVisible)&#96;\n  - Lines 186-198: Same replacement for &#96;didBecomeActiveNotification&#96; handler\n\n### 3. Update iPad_DevicesView.swift\n- Remove &#96;refreshAllDeviceLocations&#96; method (lines 294-334)\n- Remove &#96;@State private var lastDeviceListRefresh: Date? = nil&#96; (line 21)\n- Replace refresh calls:\n  - Line 142: &#96;await DeviceLocationRefresher.shared.refreshAllDeviceLocations(forceGeocoding: true)&#96;\n  - Lines 163-175: Replace notification handler with call to &#96;DeviceLocationRefresher.shared.refreshIfNeeded(isVisible: isVisible)&#96;\n  - Lines 177-189: Same replacement for &#96;didBecomeActiveNotification&#96; handler\n\n## Design Decisions\n\n1. **Shared Throttling**: The refresher manages a single &#96;lastRefresh&#96; timestamp, so both views share the same throttle. This prevents redundant API calls when both views are visible.\n\n2. **Visibility Parameter**: Views pass their &#96;isVisible&#96; state to the refresher, keeping view-specific concerns local while centralizing refresh logic.\n\n3. **Force Geocoding**: Manual refresh (pull-to-refresh) still uses &#96;forceGeocoding: true&#96; to ensure fresh geocoding data.\n\n4. **Error Handling**: Maintain existing behavior - on error, remove all device locations from cache and return &#96;false&#96;.\n\n## Files to Modify\n- &#96;miataru/LocationManagers/DeviceLocationRefresher.swift&#96; (new file)\n- &#96;miataru/views/iPhone/iPhone_DevicesView.swift&#96;\n- &#96;miataru/views/iPad/iPad_DevicesView.swift&#96;",

## Summary

1. Created `DeviceLocationRefresher.swift` in `LocationManagers/`:
   - Singleton with shared throttling state
   - `refreshAllDeviceLocations(forceGeocoding:)` — core refresh logic
   - `shouldRefresh(isVisible:)` — checks throttle, visibility, app state, and settings
   - `refreshIfNeeded(isVisible:forceGeocoding:)` — convenience method combining checks and refresh

2. Updated `iPhone_DevicesView.swift`:
   - Removed `lastDeviceListRefresh` state variable
   - Removed duplicate `refreshAllDeviceLocations` method (42 lines)
   - Replaced all refresh calls with `DeviceLocationRefresher.shared` methods
   - Simplified notification handlers (removed duplicate throttling logic)

3. Updated `iPad_DevicesView.swift`:
   - Removed `lastDeviceListRefresh` state variable
   - Removed duplicate `refreshAllDeviceLocations` method (41 lines)
   - Replaced all refresh calls with `DeviceLocationRefresher.shared` methods
   - Simplified notification handlers (removed duplicate throttling logic)

## Benefits

- Eliminated ~83 lines of duplicate code
- Centralized refresh logic in one place
- Shared throttling prevents redundant API calls when both views are visible
- Easier maintenance — future changes only need to be made in one place
- No linter errors — all code compiles correctly

The refactoring maintains existing behavior while reducing complexity and the risk of code drift between the iPhone and iPad implementations.

        "contents": "class DeviceLocationCacheStore: ObservableObject {\n    static let shared = DeviceLocationCacheStore()\n    \n    @Published var locations: [CachedDeviceLocation] = [] {\n        didSet {\n            save()\n        }\n    }\n    private let fileName = \"deviceLocations.plist\"\n    private let geocoder = CLGeocoder()\n    private var geocodeQueue: [String] = []\n    private var isProcessingGeocode: Bool = false\n    private var geocodeDistanceThresholdMeters: CLLocationDistance {\n        CLLocationDistance(SettingsManager.shared.reverseGeocodingThresholdMeters)\n    }\n    \n    private var fileURL: URL {\n        AppDirectories.applicationSupportFile(named: fileName)\n    }\n    \n    private init() {\n        self.locations = load()\n        // Enqueue reverse geocoding for any cached entries missing placemarks or timezone\n        for loc in locations where (loc.country == nil &amp;&amp; loc.locality == nil) || loc.timeZone == nil {\n            enqueueGeocodingIfNeeded(for: loc.deviceID)\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func save() {\n        do {\n            let data = try NSKeyedArchiver.archivedData(withRootObject: locations, requiringSecureCoding: true)\n            try data.write(to: fileURL)\n        } catch {\n            debugLog(\"Error saving device locations: \\(error)\")\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func load() -&gt; [CachedDeviceLocation] {\n        guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: fileURL) else { return [] }\n        do {\n            if let locations = try NSKeyedUnarchiver.unarchivedObject(ofClasses: [NSArray.self, CachedDeviceLocation.self, NSDate.self, NSString.self], from: data) as? [CachedDeviceLocation] {\n                return locations\n            }\n        } catch {\n            debugLog(\"Error loading device locations: \\(error)\")\n            // Remove incompatible cache file to prevent repeated load failures\n            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: fileURL)\n        }\n        return []\n    }\n\n    func setLocation(for deviceID: String, latitude: Double, longitude: Double, accuracy: Double, timestamp: Date, batteryLevel: Double? = nil, altitude: Double? = nil, speed: Double? = nil) {\n        if let idx = locations.firstIndex(where: { $0.deviceID == deviceID }) {\n            ",

= nil, speed: Double? = nil) {\n        if let idx = locations.firstIndex(where: { $0.deviceID == deviceID }) {\n            let existing = locations[idx]\n            let moved = existing.latitude != latitude || existing.longitude != longitude\n            let updated = CachedDeviceLocation(\n                deviceID: deviceID,\n                latitude: latitude,\n                longitude: longitude,\n                accuracy: accuracy,\n                timestamp: timestamp,\n                // Preserve previous placemark to avoid UI flicker; will be updated by geocoding\n                country: existing.country,\n                locality: existing.locality,\n                timeZone: existing.timeZone,\n                batteryLevel: batteryLevel,\n                altitude: altitude,\n                speed: speed ?? existing.speed\n            )\n            locations[idx] = updated\n            if moved {\n                // Re-geocode only on significant movement or if no placemark exists yet\n                let hasPlacemark = (existing.country != nil) || (existing.locality != nil)\n                let oldLoc = CLLocation(latitude: existing.latitude, longitude: existing.longitude)\n                let newLoc = CLLocation(latitude: latitude, longitude: longitude)\n                let distance = oldLoc.distance(from: newLoc)\n                if !hasPlacemark || distance &gt;= geocodeDistanceThresholdMeters {\n                    enqueueGeocodingIfNeeded(for: deviceID, force: true)\n                }\n            }\n            WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()\n        } else {\n            let newLocation = CachedDeviceLocation(deviceID: deviceID, latitude: latitude, longitude: longitude, accuracy: accuracy, timestamp: timestamp, batteryLevel: batteryLevel, altitude: altitude, speed: speed)",

        "contents": "    private func areLocationsEqual(_ lhs: CachedDeviceLocation?, _ rhs: CachedDeviceLocation?) -&gt; Bool {\n        switch (lhs, rhs) {\n        case (nil, nil):\n            return true\n        case let (l?, r?):\n            return l.latitude == r.latitude &amp;&amp;\n                l.longitude == r.longitude &amp;&amp;\n                l.accuracy == r.accuracy &amp;&amp;\n                l.timestamp == r.timestamp &amp;&amp;\n                l.batteryLevel == r.batteryLevel &amp;&amp;\n                l.altitude == r.altitude &amp;&amp;\n                l.country == r.country &amp;&amp;\n                l.locality == r.locality\n        default:\n            return false\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func setupThrottledLocationSubscription() {\n        locationUpdateCancellable?.cancel()\n        let intervalSeconds: Double = max(1.0, Double(settings.mapUpdateInterval))\n        let throttleStride: RunLoop.SchedulerTimeType.Stride = .seconds(intervalSeconds)\n        let publisher = cache.$locations\n            .map { (_: [CachedDeviceLocation]) -&gt; CachedDeviceLocation? in\n                cache.getLocation(for: device.DeviceID)\n            }\n            .removeDuplicates(by: areLocationsEqual)\n            .throttle(for: throttleStride, scheduler: RunLoop.main, latest: true)\n            .receive(on: RunLoop.main)\n            .sink { (newValue: CachedDeviceLocation?) in\n                self.displayedCachedLocation = newValue\n            }\n        locationUpdateCancellable = publisher\n    }\n}\n\nextension Color {\n    init(hex: String) {\n        ",

---


Fixed the thread safety issue. The problem was that `refreshAllDeviceLocations` is async and may run on a background thread, while `DeviceLocationCacheStore` has a `@Published var locations` that must be updated on the main thread.

## Fix Applied

Wrapped all cache updates in `await MainActor.run { ... }` to ensure they execute on the main thread:

1. **Success path**: All `cache.setLocation()`, `cache.removeLocation()`, and `cache.forceGeocodingForAllDevices()` calls are now inside `MainActor.run`
2. **Error path**: Error handling that removes locations from cache is also wrapped in `MainActor.run`

This ensures that even when the async function is called from a background thread (via `Task`), all updates to the `@Published` property happen on the main thread, eliminating the warning about publishing changes from background threads.

The code now safely handles thread boundaries while maintaining the same functionality.

        "contents": "    private func startForegroundLocationTimer() {\n        debugLog(\"Starting foreground location timer\")\n        stopForegroundLocationTimer()\n        foregroundLocationTimer = Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: foregroundLocationUpdateTimerTimeframe, repeats: true) { [weak self] _ in\n            guard let self = self else { return }\n            if UIApplication.shared.applicationState == .active &amp;&amp; self.isTracking {\n                debugLog(\"[Timer] Requesting location...\")\n                self.locationManager.requestLocation()\n            } else {\n                debugLog(\"[Timer] Not active or not tracking, skipping requestLocation\")\n            }\n        }\n        RunLoop.main.add(foregroundLocationTimer!, forMode: .common)\n        debugLog(\"ForegroundLocationTimer created at: \\(Unmanaged.passUnretained(foregroundLocationTimer!).toOpaque())\")\n    }\n    \n    private func stopForegroundLocationTimer() {\n        if let timer = foregroundLocationTimer {\n            debugLog(\"Stopping foreground location timer at: \\(Unmanaged.passUnretained(timer).toOpaque())\")\n        } else {\n            debugLog(\"stopForegroundLocationTimer called, but timer was already nil\")\n        }\n        foregroundLocationTimer?.invalidate()\n        foregroundLocationTimer = nil\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Background Tracking API\n    func startBackgroundTracking() {\n        guard settings.trackAndReportLocation else { return }\n        startSignificantChangeUpdates()\n    }\n    \n    func stopBackgroundTracking() {\n        stopTracking()\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - App Delegate Extension\n    func applicationDidEnterBackground(_ application: UIApplication) {\n        startBackgroundTracking()\n    }\n    \n    func applicationWillEnterForeground(_ application: UIApplication) {\n        stopBackgroundTracking()\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - App Lifecycle Hooks\n    func appDidEnterForeground() {\n        debugLog(\"[LocationManager] App did enter foreground\")",

        "contents": "    private func updateTrackingMode() {\n        let state = UIApplication.shared.applicationState\n        let status = locationManager.authorizationStatus\n        debugLog(\"updateTrackingMode called, state: \\(state.rawValue), status: \\(status.rawValue), isTracking: \\(isTracking)\")\n        switch status {\n        case .authorizedAlways, .authorizedWhenInUse:\n            if isTracking {\n                if state == .active {\n                    startHighAccuracyUpdates()\n                } else {\n                    startSignificantChangeUpdates()\n                }\n            } else {\n                // Ensure updates are stopped but preserve user's tracking preference flag\n                stopHighAccuracyUpdates()\n                stopSignificantChangeUpdates()\n            }\n        case .notDetermined:\n            // Do not reset isTracking while the user has not decided yet\n            break\n        case .denied, .restricted:\n            // Explicitly stop tracking if permission is denied/restricted\n            stopTracking()\n            // Update the setting to reflect the actual permission state\n            if settings.trackAndReportLocation {\n                settings.trackAndReportLocation = false\n            }\n        @unknown default:\n            stopHighAccuracyUpdates()\n            stopSignificantChangeUpdates()\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func startHighAccuracyUpdates() {\n        debugLog(\"Calling startHighAccuracyUpdates\")",

        "contents": "    private func handleIncomingURL(_ url: URL) {\n        guard url.scheme == \"miataru\" else { return }\n        let deviceID = (url.host ?? \"\").uppercased()\n        guard !deviceID.isEmpty else { return }\n\n        Task { @MainActor in\n            // When resuming from background, SwiftUI may restore navigation state after the URL\n            // event is delivered. Deferring slightly ensures the deep link wins over restoration.\n            await Task.yield()\n            try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 180_000_000)\n\n            // If the device already exists, navigate to it; otherwise fall back to add flow.\n            if KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices.contains(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID }) {\n                showAddDeviceSheet = false\n                pendingDeviceID = nil\n                SettingsManager.shared.lastOpenedDeviceID = deviceID\n            } else {\n                pendingDeviceID = deviceID\n                showAddDeviceSheet = true\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nprivate struct DeviceWindowEntrypoint: View {\n    @Binding var deviceID: String?\n    @Environment(\\.openWindow) private var openWindow\n    @Environment(\\.dismissWindow) private var dismissWindow\n\n    init(deviceID: Binding&lt;String?&gt;) {\n        self._deviceID = deviceID\n    }\n\n    var body: some View {\n        Group {\n            if let id = deviceID {\n                iPad_DeviceMapView(deviceID: id)\n            } else {\n                Text(NSLocalizedString(\"no_device_selected\", comment: \"No device selected for this window.\"))\n            }\n        }\n        .task {\n            if LaunchGuard.isFirstActivation {\n                LaunchGuard.isFirstActivation = false\n                openWindow(id: \"main\")\n                if let id = deviceID {\n                    dismissWindow(value: id)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * iPhone_RootView.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport SwiftUI\n\nstruct iPhone_RootView: View {\n    @ObservedObject private var settings = SettingsManager.shared\n    @State private var selectedTab = 0\n\n    var body: some View {\n        TabView(selection: $selectedTab) {\n            iPhone_DevicesView()\n                .tabItem {\n                    Label(\"devices\", systemImage: \"iphone.gen3.badge.location\")\n                }\n                .tag(0)\n            iPhone_GroupsView()\n                .tabItem {\n                    Label(\"groups\", systemImage: \"person.3\")\n                }\n                .tag(1)\n            iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView()\n                .tabItem {\n                    Label(\"qr\", systemImage: \"qrcode\")\n                }\n                .tag(2)\n            iPhone_SettingsView()\n                .tabItem {\n                    Label(\"settings\", systemImage: \"gear\")\n                }\n                .tag(3)\n        }\n        .environmentObject(DeviceGroupStore.shared)\n        .environmentObject(RouteInfoState.shared)\n        .environmentObject(SettingsManager.shared)\n        .bottomAccessory(onTap: nil)\n        .adaptiveToolbarBackground()\n        .onChange(of: settings.lastOpenedDeviceID) { _, newValue in\n            if newValue != nil {\n                selectedTab = 0\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    iPhone_RootView()\n}",

Fixed the thread safety issue. `shouldRefresh` is now async and uses `await MainActor.run` to access `UIApplication.shared.applicationState` on the main thread.

## Fix Applied

1. Made `shouldRefresh` async: changed from `func shouldRefresh(isVisible: Bool) -> Bool` to `func shouldRefresh(isVisible: Bool) async -> Bool`
2. Wrapped application state check: moved `UIApplication.shared.applicationState == .active` into `await MainActor.run { ... }` to ensure it runs on the main thread
3. Updated call site: changed `refreshIfNeeded` to use `await shouldRefresh(isVisible: isVisible)` since the method is now async

The code now safely:
- Accesses `UIApplication.shared.applicationState` on the main thread
- Updates `@Published` properties on the main thread
- Maintains the same functionality while being thread-safe

This resolves the warning about accessing `UIApplication.applicationState` from a non-main thread.
